# Gustavo Sanchez

> Gustavo Sanchez is a full-stack software engineer in San Francisco who builds accessible, AI-powered web products with strong systems thinking, spec-driven planning, and modern TypeScript and Python stacks.

This is Gustavo's official portfolio. He is an electronic and telecommunications engineer from Colombia, now focused on full-stack software engineering and practical AI applications. He is open to full-time roles and product collaborations.

## Portfolio

- [About Gustavo](https://www.gustavosanchez.dev/#intro): Background, engineering approach, and current focus.
- [Technical stack](https://www.gustavosanchez.dev/#stack): React, TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js, Express, Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Prisma, AI tooling, testing, and deployment.
- [Projects](https://www.gustavosanchez.dev/#projects): Full-stack AI applications, developer tools, and accessible frontend work.
- [Writing](https://www.gustavosanchez.dev/#blog): Articles about software engineering and building AI-powered products.
- [Contact](https://www.gustavosanchez.dev/#contact): Professional inquiries and availability.

## Selected projects

- [EnglishChunks.guru](https://englishchunks.guru): A privacy-conscious daily English speaking coach with open-model pronunciation scoring, AI feedback, progress tracking, subscriptions, and an administration workflow.
- [IdiomsMasterGirl](https://github.com/gusanchefullstack/idioms-master-girl): A local-first English idiom coach using Gemma and faster-whisper, built spec-first.
- [Nelson Personal Budget App](https://fsdev-nelson-frontend.vercel.app): A full-stack budgeting product with forecasting, reporting, authentication, and accessible responsive interfaces.
- [FX Checker](https://fsdev-foreign-exchange-checker.vercel.app): A tested currency intelligence interface with live rates, history, comparison, export, and offline fallback.
